issues.description: The problem statement specifies that Course.addRating(stars:) should return a Bool (true if the rating was valid, false otherwise). However, both the template and the solution declare/implement addRating(stars:) as a Void method (no return value). This is a structural mismatch: students reading the spec will implement a Bool-returning method, but the provided template/supported solution use a different signature. It can cause confusion about the expected API and lead to failing tests or mismatched implementations.
issues.suggested_fix: Align the method signature across all artifacts. Change the template and solution to declare addRating(stars:) -> Bool and implement it to return true when the stars value is valid (1...5) and the rating is appended, otherwise return false. Example: func addRating(stars: Int) -> Bool { if stars >= 1 && stars <= 5 { ratings.append(stars); return true } else { return false } } This preserves the pedagogical intent (students handle validation and returned success) and removes the mismatch between spec, template, and solution.
